errors.text: The proposed Miedema-plus-vibrational-entropy regressor does not reconstruct the central MTP-enabled DFT free-energy perturbation methodology or its replacement of EAM-based thermodynamic integration.

It treats entropy of fusion as ΔSconf + ΔSvib. Fusion entropy is the liquid-minus-solid entropy difference and generally requires configurational, vibrational, electronic, and other contributions for both phases; RlnN cannot simply be added as the fusion configurational entropy.
The hypothesis does not provide a method for predicting heat capacity, despite heat capacity being an explicit requested property.

The cited evidence concerns phase-formation descriptors, configurational entropy, and refractory-alloy behavior; it does not validate training a model on vibrational entropy corrections to predict melting free energies or entropy of fusion.

The claim that CALPHAD systematically overestimates intermetallic stability because the number of binary interactions grows quadratically is not established and mischaracterizes how assessed multicomponent thermodynamic databases operate.
